title: Law-text captures behind the owner's reviewer's check: the mixed-building floor-area section, the ZR 12-10 definitions behind the energy exclusion, the section ZR 23-20 points to for certain areas, and the sections that say whether parking, loading berths and bicycle parking are required; source text only (D-090 R291, R513, R516, R517, R526)
objective: Capture, as source text only, the law texts behind the check by the owner's reviewer (project-control/directives/D-090-product-plan-2026-09-28-start-building/source-055-amendment.md), from the official Zoning Resolution site, each in a file of its own under docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1/ in the form of the existing captures, with the synced copy under services/api/app/_zr_snapshots/v1/. THE TARGETS are named by what they are. A section number given here is the reviewer's LEAD, to be confirmed at the site; the builder reports the number, title and page the site shows, and where the site differs from the lead it says so in the report. (1) THE MIXED-BUILDING FLOOR-AREA SECTION of Article III, Chapter 5 that the reviewer names as 35-31, whole; if its page is a parent, the list of its child sections by number and title as the site shows it, and each child that states how the floor areas of the uses of a mixed building combine or how shared floor area is attributed. (2) THE ZR 12-10 DEFINITIONS behind the energy exclusion of the 'floor area' definition, each whole: 'fully electrified building' and 'ultra low energy building'; and every defined term those two definitions rest on for eligibility that is not captured yet. (3) THE SECTION ZR 23-20 POINTS TO for certain areas (it names Section 23-24), whole or, if a parent, with its list of children. (4) PARKING, LOADING AND BICYCLE PARKING, the sections that say WHETHER a requirement applies (not the design standards): (a) for accessory off-street parking for residences in a Residence District: the section of Article II, Chapter 5 that states the requirement for R6 to R12 districts or by transit zone, the general section on its applicability, and each section those two point to for a waiver or reduction on a small lot or for a small number of spaces; (b) the counterpart sections of Article III, Chapter 6 for a commercial overlay's residences and local retail uses, loading berths included; (c) bicycle parking: the section the reviewer names as 25-811 with its parent, and the commercial-district counterpart. Group (4) is bounded at twenty captures: what the builder finds beyond that is listed in the report as 'found, not captured', with its number and title. For each target: search the exact title, the inverted title and combined titles; a term is reported as 'not defined in ZR 12-10' ONLY after all three and with the search shown. A term defined inside another article is captured with that article whole. Tables cell by cell. Each capture carries the page address, the time of each request, the amendment date the page shows, the verbatim text and its digests, and the channel used (the print/PDF channel where it answers; the disclosed fallback where it does not). ALSO, FROM THE OFFICIAL PAGES AND WITHOUT ANY READING: a list, in the report, of each statement of law in the reviewer's message with the section the site shows for it and the capture id that now holds it (new or existing), so that a later reader can check the message against the text; where the builder cannot find the text a statement rests on, it says 'not found' with the searches. The captures are NOT a reading: no rule, no reference case, no register entry, no record and no result changes, and the report draws no conclusion about what any text means for a lot or whether the reviewer's statement is right.
business_reason: The reviewer's corrections rest on law text that the repository does not hold: the mixed-building section, the two energy definitions, and the sections that decide whether parking, loading and bicycle parking apply to an option. The owner's rule is that a statement of law is checked at its official source before a record changes (R517) and that a legal reading not captured and read is withheld. Capturing is the first half; the independent reading follows in a later task.
